slides.headline: AI DROVE 8 MILES FOR $27. FIVE MORE JOBS IT IS UNDERCUTTING
slides.kicker: IT STARTED WITH A $27 TAXI RIDE
slides.image_prompt: Elon Musk waist-up in the back seat of a Tesla Cybercab, grinning with triumphant delight directly at camera, both hands thrusting a small paper receipt stamped '$27' in large bold red numerals toward the lens; the empty pedal-free front compartment is clearly visible behind him — no steering wheel, no controls; the Tesla logo exactly as in the reference image glows as a large warm-white neon emblem on the headrest panel; Austin amber city lights blur warmly through the rear window; electric blue LED strips saturate the cabin interior. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain. Accent: electric blue against warm amber.

slides.headline: 1) A DRIVERLESS TAXI DROVE 8 MILES FOR $27
slides.body:
In Austin today, **four Tesla Robotaxi rides** covered **8 miles** and **50 minutes** for **$27.25 total**.

One Uber ride that same day cost **$33** for just **20 minutes** of travel.

slides.headline: 2) ONE AI REPLACED 700 KLARNA WORKERS AND SAVED $40M
slides.body:
Klarna's AI handled **two-thirds of all customer service chats** in its first month and saved **$40 million** that year.

It did the work of **700 full-time agents** in **February 2024**.
SAVED IN ONE YEAR. ONE AI. THE WORK OF 700 PEOPLE

slides.headline: 3) A STUDENT SOLD A $20 AI BUILD FOR $317,000
slides.body:
A student with no coding background sold an AI-built product for **$317,000** after spending **$20** on Claude.

He shipped in **9 days**. Hiring a developer for the same work would have cost thousands.

slides.headline: 4) JPMORGAN AI READ 12,000 CONTRACTS IN SECONDS
slides.body:
JPMorgan's COIN system reviews **12,000 commercial loan agreements** in **seconds**. The same work used to take their legal team **360,000 hours** a year.

The contracts still get signed. The legal teams are smaller.

slides.headline: 5) CEO SWAPPED 27 WORKERS FOR $2 A DAY
slides.body:
In **2023**, Suumit Shah, CEO of Dukaan, replaced his **27 customer support workers** with one AI chatbot.

The human team cost **$85,000 a month**. The AI costs **$2 a day**, about **$60 a month**.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 JOBS AI DOES FOR LESS THAN A HUMAN
slides.body:
• Driving: $27 AI, $33 human
• Customer service: 700 workers, $40M
• Software: $20 spent, $317K sold
• Legal review: 360K hours, now seconds
• Support: 27 workers, $2 a day

caption:
Swipe through each one. 👇 Five real cases where AI is already cheaper than the human doing the job, starting with a $27 taxi in Austin this morning.

Slide 2: Tesla Robotaxi goes 8 miles for $27.25 while an Uber charges $33 for less, slide 3: Klarna's AI replaces 700 agents saving $40M in a year, slide 4: the $40 million figure, slide 5: a student spends $20 on Claude and sells the build for $317,000 in nine days, slide 6: JPMorgan COIN reads 12,000 legal contracts in seconds replacing 360,000 lawyer hours a year, slide 7: Dukaan CEO Suumit Shah replaces 27 support workers with AI at $2 a day versus $85,000 a month, slide 8: five-job recap checklist.

AI is cheaper than a person for driving, customer service, software builds, legal review, and support staffing. These happened. The window to move first is closing.
